name: Fuentesoto (Spain)
description: Square flag gyronny of eight pieces, four white and four red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuentesoto (trees and a house on white and red above waves and a crescent).
history: Fuentesoto adopted its arms and flag officially on 20 June 2005; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1:1, gyronny of eight pieces, 4 white and 4 red, with the municipal arms in its colours superimposed at the centre.
